decision.summary: No new action: the bullish extension thesis has cooled materially and there is still no clean bearish entry to replace it.
decision.rationale: Beecthor still frames the move as a larger corrective rebound, but the cleaner intraday extension signal has faded. BTC remains below the 79.48k confirmation area he highlighted, Binance has cooled to neutral over the last 12 to 24 hours, and open interest is flat to slightly softer. The nearest bullish daily candidate, 79k reach, has collapsed to about 11.5%, which is too weak to justify a fresh entry, while bearish dailies and weeklies remain even weaker and still do not offer a clean same-day execution edge. With no open positions and no strong confirmation in either direction, the disciplined decision is NO_ACTION.
